# dash0_dataset (Resource)

Manages a Dash0 dataset. Datasets are organization-level resources identified by an immutable slug.

~> **Note:** Destroying a dataset soft-deletes it. Dashboards, views, check rules, synthetic checks, recording rules, SLOs and time series aggregations are kept for 30 days; applying the same slug within that time restores them. Spam filters are not restored. After 30 days the dataset, its permissions and those assets are removed. Telemetry is removed as its retention expires.

The slug is set in `metadata.labels["dash0.com/id"]` and cannot change: changing it replaces the dataset (destroy, then create under the new slug). `spec.permissions` is not managed by this resource yet: it is ignored on create and when detecting drift. Spec settings you omit (retention, privacy, processing) keep the server's values without causing a diff.

The dataset document follows the Dash0 API dataset document (`apiVersion: dash0.com/v1alpha1`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage a Dash0 dataset declaratively. A dataset is an isolated slice of
# telemetry with its own retention, privacy, and ingestion settings.
# Datasets are organization-level resources (no dataset scope).
#
# metadata.labels."dash0.com/id" is the dataset slug. It is required and
# cannot be changed after creation; changing it destroys and re-creates the
# dataset.
#
# Destroying the resource soft-deletes the dataset. Dashboards, views, check
# rules, synthetic checks, recording rules, SLOs and time series aggregations
# are kept for 30 days; applying the same slug within that time restores them.
# Spam filters are not restored. After 30 days the dataset, its permissions and
# those assets are removed. Telemetry is removed as its retention expires.
resource "dash0_dataset" "staging" {
  dataset_yaml = <<-YAML
apiVersion: dash0.com/v1alpha1
kind: Dash0Dataset
metadata:
  name: Staging
  labels:
    dash0.com/id: staging
spec:
  retention:
    traces: 30d
    logs: 60d
  privacy:
    ipAddresses:
      endUser:
        storage: anonymize
    geoLocation:
      endUser:
        storage: up_to_country
    redaction:
      cardholderData:
        enabled: true
      genAi:
        conversation: redact
        toolCalls: disabled
        errors: disabled
YAML
}

# The dataset slug, for use as the `dataset` of other resources.
output "staging_dataset_slug" {
  value = dash0_dataset.staging.id
}

# You can also load the YAML definition from a file:
#
# resource "dash0_dataset" "staging" {
#   dataset_yaml = file("${path.module}/datasets/staging.yaml")
# }
```

## Omitted fields

When you remove a field from `dataset_yaml`, Dash0 keeps its current value and Terraform stops checking that field for drift.
To reset a field, set it to the value you want (usually the default) and keep it in the YAML.
See the [Dash0 API reference](https://www.dash0.com/docs/api-reference) for the fields and their defaults.

## Destroying a dataset

Destroying a dataset is a soft delete.
Dashboards, views, check rules, synthetic checks, recording rules, SLOs and time series aggregations are kept for 30 days.
Apply the same configuration again within that time to restore them.
Spam filters are not restored.
After 30 days, the dataset, its permissions and those assets are removed.
Telemetry is removed as its retention expires.

To guard against an accidental destroy, add `prevent_destroy` to the resource:

```terraform
resource "dash0_dataset" "production" {
  dataset_yaml = <<-YAML
apiVersion: dash0.com/v1alpha1
kind: Dash0Dataset
metadata:
  name: Production
  labels:
    dash0.com/id: production
spec:
  retention:
    traces: 30d
YAML

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `dataset_yaml` (String) The dataset definition in YAML, following the Dash0 API dataset document: `apiVersion: dash0.com/v1alpha1`, `kind: Dash0Dataset`, `metadata.name` for the display name, `metadata.labels["dash0.com/id"]` for the slug, and optional `spec` settings (`retention`, `privacy`, `processing`, `preferred`). Server-managed metadata is stripped from the state on read.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The dataset slug, taken from `metadata.labels["dash0.com/id"]` in `dataset_yaml`.
- `origin` (String) A unique identifier for the dataset, generated by the provider on creation. Null for datasets imported without an origin.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
# Datasets are organization-scoped, so the import ID is the dataset slug
# (the `dash0.com/id` label) — no dataset prefix.
terraform import dash0_dataset.staging staging
```
